title: Simple cantilevering canopy analysis
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) analysis of a cantilevering canopy of beam members supported on columns. Use for bus stop, entrance, or roof overhang structures where members cantilever from supports. The template runs Karamba's Optimize Cross Section before Analyse, so member sections are auto-sized from a range before the reported solve. ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN drives a vertical point load at every model node (the template's area-load-on-mesh branches go inert with external geometry); self weight stays active. Limits: no per-element utilization output (strength check falls back to deflection/L250); cantilever deflection limits are stricter in practice (L/180 of the overhang) - judge accordingly. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 01_SimpleCanopy.ghx by GH_IO XML surgery. VERIFIED 2026-08-30: 2 columns + 2 cantilever arms + 2 edge beams (6 lines, mm doc auto-scaled), 3 kN/node, fixed bases -> tip movement 39.9 mm, mass 851 kg. Support DOFs are set fully fixed in the harness (the template's pinned collinear bases leave a free rotation axis). TRIAL NOTE: Karamba splits/doubles elements internally - keep input sets to roughly 6-8 lines on a trial license (8 already exceeded the 20-element cap in one test).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Canopy member axis lines (columns + cantilevering beams), node-merged at shared endpoints.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN
inputs.description: Vertical point load in kN applied at every model node (drives the template's Unit-Z vector).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
